verdict.rationale: Rippling documents a workflow builder that lets users create automations (e.g., trigger Slack alerts based on Zendesk tickets, automate reminders/admin tasks) which run without manual intervention once configured, and platform APIs/integrations that auto-provision/deprovision and sync data. However, these are traditional rule-based business workflows rather than AI-driven autonomous agents, and there's no evidence of continuous background AI-agent execution, monitoring, or independent corroboration of these workflows running unattended long-term. Missing for 10: dedicated AI-agent/autonomous-background-execution framework, independent hands-on validation of workflows running unsupervised, and clarity on how 'autonomous' vs scheduled/triggered these workflows truly are.
